# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.


# calculation and propagation of new track residual weighhting scheme
Following the studies of 20260412.md and 20260411-* we have found a fatal flaw in the track residual scheme. As of now it corrects for track upto 200 GeV, but this includes some muons since its only at a > 20 GeV cut that we allow muons into the track list. Our results will only go out to a max track pT of 15, but since many taskas are downstream of the track residuals it does effect the systematics and the central values. As we saw in 20260412 narrowing the residual correction to <15 completely fixed the massive muon-track systematic uncertainty. We will now implement this for all track residuals.

## redefiniton of track residuals
Hard code the follow scheme for track residual correction at `MainAnalysis/20251211_ResidualCorrection/workspace`. Modify the track pT binning scheme to be 26-bin from 0.5 to 15 GeV in track pT. Remove the flag that lets us set the max track pT bin. The 0.5-15 scheme will be permanent. Ensure the following rules are followed at the track residual correction step:
 - muon-track rejection, weather isMuTagged or trackMuDR is used, the same track cut should be applied to both mc reco and gen. Implement the same format as rejectMuonMatchedTrack in the main analysis. This is applied at the track selection level.
Apply condition only to reco MC:
 - track selection loose/tight, applied when selecting the loose / nominal / tight tree from the skim root file. 
 - track correction weight variation, applied when we scale the track weight up or down by 0.976 or 1.024.
Applied to neither reco or mc:
 - pile-up (only applied to data), but we still calculate the track residuals since the VZ and Z weights induce new track weights
 - ScaleFactor (only applied to data), no residual corrections
 - energy extrapolation, no residual since energy weight calculate post-track residual.

## recalculation of track residuals
The track residuals should be recalculated for ALL instances a track residual file `OFFICIAL_R_WEIGHT_FILE_*` is shown in `OfficialWeightDictionary.sh`, i.e. for the nominal result case and each of the systematic variation cases. You can assume that the VZ weights and Z weights the proceede this step are ok. Complete this using todays date 20260412 in file names where appropriate. Complete this for the standard Z pT 0-10 10-20 20-40 40-500 binning spread and following the guidlines in "redefinition of track residuals". For the correction value histogram plots written at `MainAnalysis/20251211_ResidualCorrection/workspace/plots` make sure the max track pT value is set to 15 GeV now.

### muon-track systematic redefinition
We have been using trackMuDR=0.004 and isMuTagged=false here and there for the muon-track systematic variation. We now settle on isMuTagged=false as the official muon-track variation. Change the residual correction, energy extrapolation, and systematics runner scripts accordingly. Remove the trackMuDR files from the directory, and update the isMuTaggedFalse ones from now on.

### closure of track residuals
For the nominal case remake the track residual closure plots at `Plots/20251202_trackResidualClosure`. Push these new plots to the overleaf.

### energy extrapolation weights for pp
Note the energy extrapolation weights depend on track residual correction so should be recalculated using the data-driven approach using the new weights. Do this at `MainAnalysis/20260222_EnergyExtrapolation`.

## propagation of new track residuals
We now propagate the new track corrections to all plots in the overleaf which might use these corrections - this will be ALL plots from Section 6 "Analysis" and onwards . We will produce plots using the following kinematic selections:
 - "Inclusive": Z pT 0-500, trk pT 0.5-15 (one selection)
 - "Scan" : Z pT {0-30, 30-500}, trk pT {0.5-2, 2-4, 4-15} (2x3=6 selections)
Look at the current version of the analysis note for an understanding of which selections go in which section. We quote our final result in all of these. The analysis should be rerun referencing the refereshed weights in the dictionary and using runner scripts from the main analysis directory `MainAnalysis/20241102_ZhadronVsZPt`. Modification of existing runner scripts or addition of runner scripts here is ok to avoid recalling `system-analysis.sh` with the same exact inputs, flags, and Z/trk pT selection. Still maintain the style of the repository. Use nmix=10 and the current offical tag in the dictionary when rerunning productions. The following peices of analysis should be refreshed:
 - all closure plots for the central values in pp MC before and after background substraction. Make these with `Plots/20260120_CentralClosure/`. At this step an audit should be made for the closure at MC-level after background subtraction. These plots should close reasonable well. If they do not then bug hunt and report the issues. If they are silly then fix and continue the plotting campaign.
 - combining pPb and Pbp data plots. Make these at `Plots/20260213_Central/plot_central_overlay_PPbPbP.cpp`. 
 - all systematics plots should be made new. We use the standard that pPb+Pbp plots for systematics should always be made for the "combined" sets, and all pp plots are made energy extrpolated to 8.16 TeV. Also calculate the new total systematic uncertainties for pp and pPb+Pbp and difference systematic uncetainties. pp should display curves now for (TrackSelection, TrackCorrection, MuonRejection, PU, ScaleFactor, EnergyExtrapolation, Total) and pPb+Pbp should display (TrackSelection, TrackCorrection, MuonRejection, PU, ScaleFactor, Total). Make these at `Systematics/`. Use the inclusive selection for plots displayed in the systematics section of the note and store the scan selections in the appendix (as is done now).
 - result plots. Remake these plots for energy extrapolated pp and combined pPb sets for the present kinematic selections. Apply the systematic uncertainties as is done now to the central correlation values and the difference plots.
Copy the new plots to the overleaf. Preserve the exact file name when you copy. Make minimal edits in the text just to cite the figure .pdf and to change obvious typos or incorrect labels. In general, use the overleaf as a guide for what plots and what selections to redo. Reference the overleaf if guidance is needed.



# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. Update copilot instructions on the new norms detailed here and learned by you or the subanalyzer throught these tasks.
